productWorkspace.title: Product details
productWorkspace.description: Review this product’s saved details and recorded AI comparisons.

method.title: About these numbers
method.description: Win rates use recorded product comparisons. Products and models without comparisons have no measured rate. Field coverage counts six saved fields: title, description, price, image, SKU and structured data. It does not assess how persuasive the content is.

models.title: Results by model
models.description: Recorded simulations, not live shopping traffic.

audit.title: AI content review
audit.description: Request a review of the wording, product facts and audience fit. Your saved listing stays unchanged.
audit.failed: The AI review could not be completed. Your saved product details are unchanged.
audit.coverageDescription: Presence of saved fields is separate from the AI content review.

productWorkspace.noReasoning: No written reasoning was saved for this comparison.

empty.title: No comparisons yet
empty.description: This product has no recorded AI comparisons. Its win rate will appear after it has been compared with competitors.

error.title: This product could not be loaded
error.description: Your catalog is still saved. Try loading this product again.

missing.title: Product not found
missing.description: This product may have been removed or may belong to another store. Open the catalog to choose a product.

productWorkspace.publishDescription: Generate an optimized title and description for {title} and publish them to the connected store, replacing the current listing.
